name: Piano Key Glacier
description: A massive glacier calving into the sea, but each iceberg is a perfect piano key — white and black — that plays a note as it flips and floats away, creating an endless arctic symphony.
prompt: Arctic glacier face calving piano key icebergs into dark ocean, each iceberg perfectly shaped as piano keys — ivory white and ebony black with subtle wood grain texture in ice, keys flip and rotate as they float away producing visible sound waves as musical notation in the frigid air, aurora borealis dances overhead reflecting on water, misty breath of notes rises, hyperrealistic ice textures, dramatic lighting, 8k, wide panoramic view showing endless keyboard stretching into mist
caption:
The Earth plays its own requiem — one key at a time. 🎹🧊

Listen. The ice remembers every melody.
